name: AppUi::Tag
description: A tag in the Task Board look: border and text in the variant colour on a tint of it, optionally removable.

variant.description: The colour: default, primary, info, success, warning or danger

colorKey.description: Text to pick the palette colour from, used when there is no @variant; the same text always gets the same colour

onRemove.description: Shows a remove button and is called when it is clicked
